definitions.explanation: A printing method that uses several colors of ink, as opposed to single-color (monochrome) printing; also a print made this way.

examples.japanese: {多色|たしょく}{刷|ず}りの{版画|はんが}。
この{絵|え}は{多色|たしょく}{刷|ず}りで{印刷|いんさつ}されている。
examples.english: This picture is printed in multiple colors.

examples.japanese: {浮世絵|うきよえ}は{多色|たしょく}{刷|ず}りの{技術|ぎじゅつ}によって、{豊|ゆた}かな{色彩|しきさい}を{表現|ひょうげん}できるようになった。
examples.english: Thanks to multicolor printing techniques, ukiyo-e came to be able to express rich color.

notes:
Composed of {多色|たしょく} (many colors) + {刷|す}り (printing). The すり becomes ずり through rendaku. Strongly associated with traditional woodblock prints such as {錦絵|にしきえ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {多色|たしょく}{刷|ず}りの{版画|はんが}: a multicolor woodblock print
- {多色|たしょく}{刷|ず}りで{印刷|いんさつ}する: to print in multiple colors

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {単色|たんしょく}{刷|ず}り: single-color printing — the contrasting one-ink method
- {錦絵|にしきえ}: brocade picture — full-color ukiyo-e produced by multicolor printing
